Jordan — quick legal POV: I agree with keeping arbitration as the default dispute resolution, but we need a narrowly tailored injunctive-relief carveout. Practical proposal below (for your redline):

1) Governing law: Delaware (to keep consistency with other enterprise templates and favorable commercial jurisprudence).
2) Jurisdiction/venue: mutual agreement that arbitration governs disputes in the ordinary course; but either party may seek emergency provisional remedies (including temporary injunctive relief) in any court of competent jurisdiction without waiving the right to arbitrate the merits.
3) Service & notice: require 48 hours' notice to Redwood legal before filing in court except in cases where ex parte relief is necessary; if filing occurs, parties agree to meet-and-confer within 24 hours and consider immediate escalation to the internal legal leaders for possible stay.

I attached inline comments in the Redwood redline. For sales: if ArgoLabs insists on CA governing law as a hard condition, escalate to me + Laura — we can discuss commercial concessions (e.g., revenue commitment or a narrow SLA guarantee) to bridge the gap.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park | Head of Commercial Legal, Redwood Inference

Jordan / Kimberly — thanks for the quick turn. After a short internal check, ArgoLabs can accept Delaware as the governing law provided Redwood agrees to the following narrow protections:

- Temporary injunctive relief and other provisional remedies may be sought in California courts (San Francisco or federal N.D. Cal) without waiving the right to arbitrate the merits.
- If Redwood files a motion to compel arbitration after such a filing, both parties will request expedited handling and seek to avoid parallel proceedings where possible.
- We will sign a short protocol (one page) that sets out notice timings and the meet-and-confer/escalation path Kimberly proposed.

If that captures the compromise, please confirm and we will send a DocuSign envelope with our cleaned-up comments. Linking our DocuSign here: https://www.docusign.com/argolabs-msaredline-12345
